### Using the Slide Decks

- **Navigation**: Use Space, Arrow Keys, or the on-screen navigation buttons.
- **Slide Overview**: Press `O` (or `Esc`) to zoom out and view all slide tiles simultaneously.
- **Chalkboard / Drawing**: Press `B` to open the interactive blackboard or click the pen icon.
- **PDF Export**: Add `?print-pdf` to the URL or open print dialog (`Ctrl + P`) in Chromium browsers.
